name: Disney Villainous: Perfectly Wretched

categories.label: Fulfilled own villain objective
categories.labelVi: Hoàn thành mục tiêu phản diện của mình
categories.hint: First player to complete their villain's unique objective wins immediately.

tiebreakers.description: No points; the first player to fulfil their objective wins, so ties do not arise.

winCondition: Each player controls a different villain with a unique win condition printed on the villain guide; the first player to fulfil it wins.

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when a player completes their villain objective.

notes: family: objective-race. Villains: Cruella de Vil, Mother Gothel, Pete. Objective text is per villain (component-printed) and not modelled; scorer only records the winner. Not verified against the official rulebook (could not be retrieved).

sources.title: Disney Villainous: Perfectly Wretched (BGG page, description only; official rulebook not retrievable in this run)
